blocks.text: Brace yourself for the king of monsters as Godzilla rips and roars at select SM cinemas October 14–20 for the first-ever, highly anticipated Godzilla Film Festival. From epic monster showdowns and city-smashing destruction to Millennium-era adventures and the critically acclaimed modern reimagining of Shin Godzilla, each film offers a different look at the character who has remained one of cinema’s most enduring icons. Five era-defining classics return to the big screen for an exclusive one-week engagement: the iconic creature battles of Mothra vs. Godzilla (1964) and the destructive spectacle of Godzilla vs. Biollante (1989), to the Millennium-era adventures of Godzilla 2000: […]...
